name: Intercom
description: Intercom customer messaging and support platform with a REST API and hosted MCP server.
auth_notes: Access Token for private apps on your own workspace; OAuth for public apps accessing other people's data. OpenAPI security scheme is bearerAuth.
gate_detail: Access tokens are for your own workspace; OAuth is for public apps. Sources do not say which plan or signup is needed to obtain credentials, and give no sandbox or free-tier detail.
api_scope: REST API reference (version 2.18) with US, EU and AU regional servers; covers workspace data such as conversations and contacts, plus help center articles via MCP.
mcp_notes: Hosted Intercom MCP server documented on developers.intercom.com; US and EU workspaces only. Endpoint URL not captured in sources.
blocker_detail: Needs an Intercom workspace; plan or signup requirements for API access are not stated in sources.

evidence.quote: To access the Intercom API, you have two authentication options depending on whether you app is public or private.
[OAuth](#oauth) is for if you're building a public app that accesses **other people's** Intercom data.
The Intercom MCP server is available for US and EU hosted workspaces.

issues: Plan or pricing requirement for API access not stated
Webhook and sandbox support not shown in sources

searches.query: Intercom API credentials pricing plan required developer access
